title: MS60034: Semiconductor Surfaces And Interfaces
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: None
Definition of surface : Kronig-Penny model, surface structure, adsorption,
space charge and surface states, field effect, surface capacitance, surface
recombination, contact potential and surface photo-voltage, transport
processes, surface characterization by diffraction, spectroscopy and
electrochemical techniques. Metal-semiconductor junction, p-n junctions, MOS
and MIS structures
